Achieve Your Fitness Goals with MyGainplan!

MyGainplan is your ultimate workout companion, designed to help you stay on track with your fitness journey while connecting with a vibrant community of fitness enthusiasts. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, MyGainplan has everything you need to plan, track, and share your workouts.

Key Features:

1. Customizable Workout Plans:
Create and add your personalized training plans.
Tailor workouts to fit your specific goals, whether it's strength training, cardio, or flexibility.

2. Interactive Workout Guidance:
Step-by-step guidance through your workouts with built-in timers.
Never miss a beat with our intuitive workout prompts and reminders.

3. Social Network for Fitness Enthusiasts:
Upload and share your workouts with the MyGainplan community.
Discover and follow other users' training routines to stay inspired and diversify your workouts.

4. Track Your Progress:
Monitor your progress and keep track of your journey.
Set milestones and celebrate your achievements.

5. Seamless Integration:
Sync your workouts with all of your devices.
Keep all your fitness data in one place for a comprehensive overview.

6. User-Friendly Interface:
Easy-to-navigate design ensures you can focus on what matters most: your workout.
Accessible for all fitness levels, from novice to expert.

7. Regular Updates:
We continuously update MyGainplan with new features and improvements based on user feedback.
Why Choose MyGainplan?

Flexibility: Adapt your training plan as your fitness level evolves.
Community: Join a global network of fitness enthusiasts.
Motivation: Stay inspired by exploring new workouts.
Results: Achieve your fitness goals faster with a structured and social approach.
Get Started Today!

Download MyGainplan now and take the first step towards a healthier, fitter you. Whether you're looking to lose weight, build muscle, or improve your overall fitness, MyGainplan is here to guide you every step of the way.

Fitness is more fun with friends! Invite your friends to join MyGainplan and start working out together. Share your progress, challenge each other, and celebrate your successes as a team.

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News!

I'm Jarne, a student and software developer, and I have developed MyGainplan for the last 2 years. When I started working out, I realized that it is quite hard to keep varying training plans. I know that it is recommended to change your training plan every 2–3 months in order to prevent muscular imbalance and other injuries. Besides that, some little changes help to stay motivated on a long fitness journey .

After endless searching for free workouts or training plans, I had the idea of MyGainplan. The main idea of MyGainplan is to allow users to share their experience and profit from each other. MyGainplan guides you through your workouts, tracks your progress and keeps you motivated to train. When it comes to discovering new workouts, MyGainplan allows you to search for unique and different workouts created and uploaded by other users. With that, changing your training plan becomes a breeze - And it's totally free! No payments, no subscriptions, no advertisements!

I am so happy to say that I have now launched on iOS and Android. I would love to get some Feedback from the first users in order to make MyGainplan even better!

Website: https://www.my-gainplan.com/
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mygainplan
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/mygainplan/id6547866696

Let's make training better together
